Breaking Down the Ending of Jessica Chastain's Nashville Thriller Heartland

Netflix's Heartland follows Misty Jones ( Jessica Chastain ), a former country music star living in self-imposed exile who returns to Nashville after her niece, an up-and-coming singer named Charlie Heart (Carter Faith), goes missing. As she investigates the disappearance, Misty uncovers a series of suspicious connections involving Charlie's manager, Roy Combs ( Garrett Hedlund ), and a local police detective.
